sensor.name: CUST - System Environment Variables - SAMPLE
sensor.description: Example of parsing specific variable called SAMPLE Please replace in sensor CUST_VAR = "SAMPLE" with variable required.

sensor_query.query:
'======================================== ' System Environment Variables '========================================
Option Explicit
Const EXPAND_VARS = False
'------------------------------------- 'EI special variable 'Please enter in this variable the env variable you want to retrieve 'Example = DIm EI_VAR '------------------------------------- Dim CUST_VAR CUST_VAR = "SAMPLE"
Dim wshShell, wshSysEnv, strItem Dim SPLITVAR,var_found Var_found = 0
Set wshShell = CreateObject( "WScript.Shell" ) Set wshSysEnv = wshShell.Environment( "SYSTEM" ) For Each strItem In wshSysEnv Splitvar = split(strItem,"=") 'WScript.Echo "var name : " & splitvar(0) & " var Value : " & splitvar(1) if strcomp(splitvar(0),CUST_VAR) = 0 then WScript.Echo splitvar(1) Var_found = 1 end if Next if var_Found = 0 then WScript.Echo "Var Not Found" end if Set wshSysEnv = Nothing Set wshShell = Nothing
